inventory.command_description: Read CT 200 Proxmox configuration, status, interfaces and recent task metadata before and after the correction probes.
inventory.tool: Proxmox HTTPS API using hermes@pve with GET requests only

operator_non_mutation.assessment: The correction session issued only Proxmox API GET requests and no guest SSH. Selected stable Proxmox configuration fields were equal before/after. A vncproxy task owned by root@pam was visible during the interval and is not attributed to this read-only API identity.
limitations: No byte-for-byte guest filesystem comparison was performed.
Runtime counters are excluded because they change without operator mutation.
This evidence does not claim that no other operator or guest process was active.

redaction: The Proxmox password and session ticket existed only in process memory. UPIDs and authentication material are omitted; retained fields contain no credentials or PII.
